name: trial-timeline
title: Trial timeline
description: A free trial told day by day: what you get today, when you are reminded and what happens at the end, so nobody wonders if they will be charged.
docs: Pass a title, three or four moments (a day label, a title, a sentence and an optional icon each), an optional description, an action and a note. The moments are an ordered list: a row when the section is wide and a column when it is narrow, decided by the width of the section itself, so it holds in a sidebar as well as on a phone. The connecting line is decoration and hidden from assistive technology. The last moment is the answer to what happens at the end, so it is emphasised by weight, a filled marker and a heavier title, never by colour. Without an icon a moment shows its step number. The action is yours: a Button or a link styled as one.
